items.title: Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1957-04-20
items.q: So Joe Alva and Jimmy Noon was with me then.

ctx.x: He was making too much money, Louie?

All the $50 of a week in Chicago, and $300, $400 a night off my dance with you. And working on wrestling. I said, why? You go out of business, go wait for someone for now. Maybe in Chicago. So Joe Alva and Jimmy Noon was with me then. He said, we'd like to go to Chicago. I said, you want a job? I said, here's a telegram. He's right. So they went? They took the job. They didn't have raise enough to get coffee from the man, Joe and Jimmy. I said, did you guys get any of your transportation to get some advance…
